name: Fermi America Project Matador campus
summary: Fermi Inc. is developing a private-power AI campus in Carson County, Texas, near Amarillo, mostly on land leased from the Texas Tech University System. Its filing describes about 11 GW of planned on-site generation, potentially expandable to about 17 GW, and about 15 million square feet of AI infrastructure space. Gas turbines come first, with nuclear units planned from 2033 and limited grid supply at the start. In August 2026 Fermi signed its first tenant lease, with TensorWave, for 222 MW of facility power. At mid-2026 it reported 1.54 billion US dollars of construction in progress and going-concern doubts that management said its plans alleviate.

location.note: Coordinates of the Pantex Plant from Wikipedia (s5). Fermi says its campus is next to the Pantex complex (s2), in Carson County (s1, s4) and near Amarillo (s3); the campus covers thousands of acres, so the point is only approximate.
